objective: Prevent pull-request Scientific Validation runs from triggering the production release workflow; publish only from successful validation of main.
previous_knowledge_consumed: release workflow run 37889771724 failed while attempting to download heavy scientific evidence from a non-main validation run

baseline.status: Release workflow triggers after every successful Scientific Validation workflow_run, including pull-request branches; release evidence download then fails for runs that do not publish heavy release artifacts.

expected_improvement: Restrict production release workflow to successful Scientific Validation runs whose head branch is main.
Avoid misleading failed release attempts from pull-request validation events.
Preserve evidence-bound release publication and existing scientific gates.

release_trigger_scope.before: Any successful Scientific Validation workflow_run can start the release job.
release_trigger_scope.after: Only a successful Scientific Validation workflow_run on main can start the release job.

release_integrity.before: Non-main validation can enter release and fail during evidence download.
release_integrity.after: Non-main validation events are skipped before release checkout and evidence acquisition.

evidence: CI, CodeQL, product-scope audit, and scientific validation must pass before merge.

root_causes: Release workflow's workflow_run trigger listened to Scientific Validation completion without restricting the source branch to main.
A successful pull-request Scientific Validation run therefore started a production release job and failed when expected heavy scientific-validation artifacts were unavailable.

findings: workflow_run release workflows must explicitly constrain the source branch before attempting release-only artifact downloads.
Pull-request scientific validation and main-branch release validation have different artifact contracts and must not share the same publication path.

open_blockers: Required checks on this PR have not yet completed.
Post-merge verification must confirm pull-request validation no longer launches a release job and successful main validation remains eligible.

knowledge_carried_forward: Never weaken scientific validation or release artifact checks to hide missing evidence.
Release workflow must be bound to successful main-branch validation and its run artifacts.
